hints.title: Initial Equality Branching
hints.text: Separate your logic depending on whether the strings already match before swapping.

hints.title: Duplicate Letter Detection
hints.text: When strings match, swapping identical characters requires at least one duplicated letter.

hints.title: Dual Mismatch Index Verification
hints.text: When strings differ, collect the mismatched indices. There must be exactly two mismatches whose characters swap to match the other string.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of input string s
complexity.notes: Single pass scanning mismatch positions with constant alphabet space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all O(N^2) character swaps and checking equality takes O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed alphabet lookup requires O(1) auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle the distinct cases of s == goal versus s != goal cleanly.
